recent.text: Maurice says Gadjovich is "still a ways" from a return, but today was a step forward. "Part of what he's dealing with, you need to get out with a lot of motion and different colors going around with more body, more chaos. He looked like he got through it."
recent.author: Jameson Olive

recent.text: Maurice on Barkov and Marchand: "It's not long now. A big tug here today. We'll see how they respond and talk to the doctors and come up with a plan." He added that Barkov is probably back slightly before Marchand. Didn't have a yes or no on Barkov playing Saturday.
